context: Sho-young watches a school play; Asuka explains acting.
purpose: Teacher explaining theatrical art to child.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 先生、男の子の演技、すごい!
lines.en: Teacher, that boy's acting was amazing!
lines.style: Bright, awed admiration. Quick intake of breath on the opening. Eyes wide. Voice lifts at the end—pure wonder without self-consciousness. Childlike conviction that this is the most impressive thing he's ever seen.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 熱い気持ち、よく演じてる。
lines.en: He really was acting with such passion.
lines.style: Warm affirming nod in the voice. Slow, deliberate pace—meeting him where his excitement is, not rushing past it. Soft focus, like she's thinking of the boy's commitment. Gentle agreement.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 俳優って、どうしてあんなにできるの?
lines.en: How do actors do that? How can they act like that?
lines.style: Genuine curiosity, not performing curiosity. Soft, wondering tone. Slight hesitation—he's working out the question as he asks it. Leans forward with interest, not demanding but earnestly puzzled.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 稽古を、何回も、重ねるのよ。
lines.en: They practice, over and over. That's how they get so good.
lines.style: Patient explanation, like sharing a secret. Slow, measured cadence. Warm but not patronizing—she trusts him to understand. Slight emphasis on the repetition. Practical and encouraging.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: I want to be on stage too!
lines.style: Sudden brightness and urgency. Voice rises with certainty and longing. The desire escapes before he can overthink it. Breathless, genuine excitement—this is a real want, not a passing idea.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 尋ねたら、先生紹介できるよ。
lines.en: If you want to try, I can help introduce you to someone.
lines.style: Encouraging, almost gentle promise. Steady, believing tone—like she's opening a door he didn't know was there. Slight warmth on 'help,' no hesitation. This is an offer she means.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: Will you come pick me up after?
lines.style: Hopeful, implicit trust. Voice tilts upward at the end—not quite a question, more like a wish he's testing out loud. Small and warm. He's checking if she'll stay part of this with him.
